policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: Turkmenistan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Bulgarian ordinary-passport visitors must obtain Turkmenistan's visa in advance through the designated diplomatic mission.
conditions: The Bulgarian MFA identifies the Turkmenistan embassies in Moscow or Ankara as application channels.
This excludes work, residence, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visa
policies.summary: Bulgarian ordinary-passport visitors can obtain Jordan's visa at the border.
conditions: The King Hussein/Allenby Bridge requires a visa arranged in advance and does not displace the general arrival route.
This excludes multiple-entry, work, residence, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: Iraq electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Bulgarian ordinary-passport visitors must apply in advance for Iraq's electronic visa.
conditions: The Bulgarian MFA states the requirement applied from 1 March 2025 to every Bulgarian citizen seeking Iraq entry.
This excludes work, residence, special documents and final admission.

application.label: Iraq electronic visa service
steps: Apply in advance using the ordinary Bulgarian passport.
Carry the approved electronic visa and meet final entry requirements.
